raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: GB-code
  version: "1.0.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/GB_code-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9e94a011a59700f25144e93149ab38b2493f51ff9910d9ef37d01e4517112011
  patches:
    - import.patch

build:
  number: 2
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - csl_generator = gb_code.csl_generator:main
      - gb_generator = gb_code.gb_generator:main

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
  run:
    - numpy >=1.14.0
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - pyyaml

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - gb_code
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - csl_generator --help
      - gb_generator

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: A Grainboundary generation code
  description: |
    This python package helps you create orthogonal grain boundary
    supercells for atomistic calculations. The code is based on the
    coincident site lattice (CSL) formulations for cubic materials
    (sc, bcc, fcc, diamond).
  homepage: https://github.com/oekosheri/GB_code
  repository: https://github.com/oekosheri/GB_code
  documentation: https://github.com/oekosheri/GB_code

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
